name: 370-new-chief
notes: #370 C3.c: the new chief, from the game's plan and beats. A horseshoe gathers at the fire, open toward the glass; the chief walks through the gap to the seat between the fire and the glass; the old chief hands the band over (the chief puts it on); sit, stand, speak to the Keeper; everyone bows in a wave, nearest first, 0.12 s apart; the gold mark pops on (the hit: gold sparks in the game) and everyone cheers.
